values.en: Proof of equivalence for map homotopy
values.zh-CN: 映射同伦等价关系的论证

values.en: The constant, reversed and concatenated homotopies prove reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity respectively, as stated in ContinuousMap.Homotopic.refl, .symm and .trans. These are exactly the three fields of the existing Equivalence predicate on C(X,Y). This concerns a relation between maps, not an equivalence between spaces.
values.zh-CN: 恒等、反向、时间拼接同伦分别证明自反性、对称性与传递性，见 ContinuousMap.Homotopic.refl、.symm、.trans。它们恰为既有 Equivalence 谓词在 C(X,Y) 上所要求的三条性质。这里是映射间关系的等价性，不是空间之间的同伦等价。
